title: `---` directly before the closing quote of a multi-line scalar is text
notes: A document marker is `---` or `...` at the start of a line and followed by a break or white space (production 206). Here `---` is followed by the closing quote, so it is text and the scalar is `x ---`. A reader that tests for the end of the text instead of the next character sees a marker when the quote is cut off.

provenance.reference: A reader that looked for a marker in the scalar's text without its closing quote and refused the input with a document marker inside a quoted scalar.
